---
title: "About this lecture"
---

This short website is a lecture about bats, and at the same time an example of what Quarto can do.
Each page shows a few of the techniques from `QUARTO.md`.

| Page | Quarto features it shows |
|---|---|
| Home | Headings, bold and italic text, lists, links, a tabset, a hidden code block (`echo: false`) |
| Bats by the numbers | Python code, code folding, a labelled figure with a cross-reference, maths, a block that isn't run (`eval: false`) |
| Try it yourself | Editable code that runs in the browser (quarto-live, `{pyodide}` blocks) |

## How to explore

Open the matching `.qmd` file next to each page and compare the two. Then change something, render, and preview:

```bash
quarto render
quarto preview
```

## Sources

The numbers on these pages are rounded and meant for fun, not for research.
For reliable information, see [Bat Conservation International](https://www.batcon.org).
